dataRoles.name: activity
dataRoles.description: The bar's identity. Each unique value renders as one horizontal bar (e.g., a project task, a campaign phase, a product release, an audit cycle).

dataRoles.name: area
dataRoles.description: Optional grouping that segments bars into swim lanes (e.g., team, department, workstream, portfolio area).

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: When the bar starts. Date column.

dataRoles.name: endDate
dataRoles.description: When the bar ends. Date column.

dataRoles.name: baselineStart
dataRoles.description: (Optional) The activity's committed (baseline) start date — what was originally planned. When bound alongside Baseline End, the glide-path layer renders a dashed baseline-bar outline on the activity row. Unbound = single-bar render unchanged from v2.2.

dataRoles.name: baselineEnd
dataRoles.description: (Optional) The activity's committed (baseline) end date. When bound, drives slip computation (current End minus Baseline End) and renders the baseline-bar layer + slip-chevron indicator showing drift direction and magnitude.

dataRoles.name: actualStart
dataRoles.description: (Optional) The activity's actual (recorded) start date — when real work began. When bound alongside Actual End, the glide-path layer renders a solid actual-segment showing real completed work.

dataRoles.name: actualEnd
dataRoles.description: (Optional) The activity's actual (recorded) end date — typically the report-as-of date for in-progress work, or the true completion date for finished work. When bound, defines the actual-segment endpoint.

dataRoles.name: milestoneActivity
dataRoles.description: FK to the parent activity name. Each milestone attaches to the bar with the matching name.

dataRoles.name: milestoneDate
dataRoles.description: When the milestone marker is placed on its parent bar.

dataRoles.name: milestoneBaselineDate
dataRoles.description: (Optional) The originally-committed date for this milestone. When bound, the milestone renders with an additional hollow outline marker at the baseline x-position plus a thin connector line to the current solid marker (MS Project Tracking Gantt convention). Hides invisibly when baseline matches current date.

dataRoles.name: milestoneType
dataRoles.description: Marker classifier — distinct values appear as one slice each in the Format pane (color/symbol/size/visibility per type).

dataRoles.name: milestoneLabel
dataRoles.description: Optional milestone text (nullable). Shown next to the marker per Label Position.

dataRoles.name: labelPosition
dataRoles.description: L | R | none. Author-controlled position of the label relative to the marker. Use 'none' to hide a single milestone's label without affecting others (per-row hide mechanism).

dataRoles.name: activityNote
dataRoles.description: Optional per-activity status note (free text). Shown in the activity tooltip on hover. Source: a text column on the Activities table — typically a 'Status' or 'Notes' column.

dataRoles.name: milestoneNote
dataRoles.description: Optional per-milestone status note (free text). Shown in the milestone tooltip on hover. Source: a text column on the Milestones table.

dataRoles.name: milestoneOwner
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Person or team accountable for the milestone. Surfaced in the milestone Inspector when bound.

dataRoles.name: milestoneStatus
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Current state — e.g. Planned / In Progress / Complete / Blocked / Skipped. Surfaced in the milestone Inspector when bound.

dataRoles.name: milestoneExternalUrl
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Clickable link surfaced in the milestone Inspector when bound.

dataRoles.name: milestoneHealth
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Status indicator — e.g. Green / Yellow / Red. Surfaced in the milestone Inspector when bound.

dataRoles.name: activityHealth
dataRoles.description: (Optional) Per-activity status/alert indicator — e.g. Green / Yellow / Red, or semantic values like 'On Track' / 'At Risk' / 'Off Track' / 'Blocked'. When bound, the activity's left bullet renders in the alert color (via Milestone Health Colors palette); when unbound, the bullet falls back to the swim-lane color.

dataRoles.name: filterDimensions
dataRoles.description: Bind columns here to surface them as in-visual filters. Up to 8 dimensions. Each binding occupies one slot (1..8) in the Filter Slots card — set its tier (Featured tab strip / Comprehensive sidebar / Both / Hidden), selection mode, and optional label override. INF-3817: this 8-cap is enforced at controller.ts:347-348; bindings 9+ are dropped with an in-panel warning chip.

dataRoles.name: percentComplete
dataRoles.description: INF-3815 — (Optional) Operator-supplied 0-100 percent completion per activity. When bound AND the Activity Inspector's progress-bar source is set to 'User field', the slide-out drawer's % complete bar reads this column instead of computing elapsed-time / total-time. Unbound = the auto elapsed-time behavior is preserved.

masterTimeSlider.description: Persisted state of the top master time slider — window (JSON-stringified SliderRange) plus scope booleans selecting which regions the filter applies to.

title.description: Power BI's built-in platform title. Off by default — use the Chart Title card below instead for richer styling. Turning this on shows the title as a separate text element above the visual viewport (PBI platform handles rendering).

chartTitle.description: Custom title rendered inside the visual at the top — independent from Power BI's built-in 'Title' card. Use this for a styled, presentation-quality title. To avoid two titles, turn the built-in Title card OFF when using Chart Title.

tooltip.description: Controls hover-tooltip behavior. The Note row appears in both activity and milestone tooltips; this card decides whether to show it and how to handle rows where the Note field is unbound or empty.

milestones.description: Marker + label controls. Max 2 milestone types (cap-2). First 2 distinct values from data bind to slots 1 and 2; displayNames in Format pane show actual type names. Data with 3+ types drops the extras.

activityHealthIcons.description: Bind each slot's icon+color to a specific value from your bound Activity Health column. Type the value to match in each slot's 'Value to match' field. Up to 5 slots; rows whose health value doesn't match any slot fall back to the swim-lane color.

filterSlots.description: Per-slot controls for each column bound to Filter Dimensions. Slot N tracks the Nth binding in role-order. Set tier (Featured tab strip / Comprehensive sidebar / Both / Hidden), selection mode (Single / Multi / Search), and optional label override per slot. Slot displayNames are overridden at runtime from the bound column's name.

filterPanelLayout.description: Panel-level layout for the in-visual filter chrome. Pinned dims render at the top of the visual; the comprehensive sidebar mounts on the right. selectionsJson persists user-selected values across .pbix save/reopen.

pinnedDensity.description: Vertical compactness of the pinned slicer strip at the top of the visual. Comfortable = larger pills + more padding; Compact = balanced default; Dense = minimal vertical footprint for many pinned dims.

milestoneHealthColors.description: Color palette for the milestone Inspector's Health dot. The visual matches the bound Milestone Health value against literal color names (Green/Yellow/Red) AND common semantic-status strings (On Track / At Risk / Off Track / Blocked / Complete / Done) — change these colors to align the palette to your domain's status taxonomy.

swimlanes.description: Width, label styling, and per-swim-lane color overrides — all consolidated here. One color picker appears per distinct Swim Lane value found in your data.

labelMaxChars.description: INF-3821 — max characters before truncation + ellipsis on swim-lane names. 0 disables. Codepoint-safe (no truncation mid-emoji). Hover the truncated label to see the full original name via SVG <title>.

useAreaColor.displayName: Use swim lane color for label

glidePath.description: Variance escalation thresholds. When a baseline date is bound, the activity bullet color derives from slip magnitude (Green pulled-in / Yellow minor / Red major-or-critical) and a thin grey reference tick renders below the bar at the baseline-end date (Smartsheet + Tufte convention). Slip-magnitude thresholds (days) drive bullet color categorization — override these to match your portfolio's drift tolerance.

slipNegligibleDays.description: Absolute slip days at or below which an activity is considered on-track (no chevron renders).

slipMinorDays.description: Absolute slip days at or below which slip is classified minor (yellow chevron).

slipMajorDays.description: Absolute slip days at or below which slip is classified major (orange chevron). Beyond this is critical (red).

timeAxis.description: Three hierarchy levels — Year, Quarter, Month. Each level can be toggled on/off. Quarter and Month tick boundaries can also render vertical gridlines through the chart body with their own color, opacity, and line style.

activityInspector.description: INF-3815 — controls the Activities slide-out drawer. Lets the operator hide the % complete bar entirely OR switch its source from auto elapsed-time to a user-bound `percentComplete` column.

ganttLayout.description: Outer margins around the Roadmap chart region. Percentages of viewport.

hiddenMode.description: Which region of the composed Roadmap+Table layout starts collapsed on report load. Mirrors the upper-right chrome Roadmap/Table toggles; INF-3819 wires those toggles through host.persistProperties so the operator's choice survives reload + publish.
